items.name: Dario Penic
items.text: I had the pleasure of working with Mateen on our mobile team. He is a highly skilled Flutter engineer who made a significant impact through his technical expertise and ownership of key features. Mateen played a key role in architecture discussions, ensuring our mobile codebase was clean and easy to maintain. He also worked closely with the backend team, proactively defining JSON responses and improving workflows.His ability to take ownership of complex tasks and consistently deliver high-quality code made a real difference to our team. I appreciated his contributions and the dedication he brought to our work.

items.name: Habib Rahal
items.text: I worked along with Mateen on multiple projects at aware and had the chance to witness his diligence first hand. He works well under pressure and is able to meet his deadlines regardless of the technical challenges he may face. Mateen is also exceptionally consistent and shows strong ownership over the tasks he works on. On a personal level he is and also a pleasure to work with, given his great sense of humor and overall positivity. I’d recommend him highly!

items.name: Saifullah
items.text: Mateen is a highly skilled and dedicated professional. He consistently goes above and beyond to ensure that projects are completed on time and to the highest standard. His attention to detail and problem-solving skills are exceptional, making him an invaluable asset to any team. He also have a positive attitude and is a great team player.

items.name: Zubair Ahmad
items.text: It was a pleasure working with Muhammad Mateen at Plexable. He is a result-oriented professional and very talented developer. I’ve seen him as a very hard-working and dedicated professional, specifically his dedication and willingness to help others in the team by providing great technical support.

items.name: Saeed Ahmad
items.text: Mateen is very helpful and result-oriented person. During working with him at AppinSnap, he always come up with unique and easy ideas to solve complex problems and meet difficult deadlines. He is one of the energetic persons.
